verdict.rationale: Teams provides real building blocks for background automations—bots/agents via the Agents Toolkit CLI, Graph API messaging, webhooks/connectors, and slash-command agents that can run independently of a live user session—but these require developer setup (Azure resources, Graph API auth) rather than a simple no-code automation builder. Community evidence explicitly notes this is heavier than competitors' webhook-only approach, requiring the 'full Azure/Graph API stack.'
